author: Elizabeth Gregory
text: I switched from android to iPhone and I had trouble using the app and struggling to get readings . I currently use my work phone ( Samsung) and works well. I took my phone to Apple Store and they said everything was ok so got in touch with Abbotts and what they told me what to do with my phone didn’t work so I am sticking to my work phone which is not ideal .
